superseded_by: tier0-v0.3.json, for the two TRANSPORT objects only. The bytes in this file remain the correct record of the layout as published and are deliberately not updated.
notes: These vectors exercise the seven currently measured Tier-0 layouts through the freestanding C99 reference codec.
The historical tier0-v0.1.json vectors remain unchanged.
TRANSPORT_OFFER uses the 8-bit transport identifier direction from field-width-review-v0.2.md.

TRANSPORT_ACCEPT was added after TRANSPORT_OFFER. Without it an offering peer never learns which transport was selected, so two independent implementations cannot complete a migration. Its assignment (category 8, opcode 1) already existed in semantic-codes-v0.2.json; only the layout is new.
transport_id values are defined by mcl-link/registries/transport-ids-v0.1.json: 1 MCL_AP, 2 MCL_IP, 3 MCL_BLE, 4 MCL_UWB. Both transport vectors here use 2, which is MCL_IP.

PROVENANCE WARNING: the TRANSPORT_OFFER field values (source_ref, endpoint_token) were borrowed from research corpus scenario S14, which describes a BLE handoff, while the encoded transport_id is 2 = MCL_IP. The bytes are correct and self-consistent; the borrowed values are not evidence that 2 means BLE. Do not infer transport assignments from vector provenance - the registry is authoritative.
session_ref in TRANSPORT_ACCEPT is a correlation reference carried in the clear. It is not a secret and proves nothing about the peer.
